scope: Canonical source fix for the two reproduced workroom latency defects; no deployment, staging or commit

tests.command: node --test company/publication-link-check.test.mjs company/post-performance.test.mjs company/automation-notifications.test.mjs company/server-publication-links.test.mjs company/server-automation-health.test.mjs company/server-workroom-schedule.test.mjs (all paths rooted at docs/마케팅/온라인마케팅지도/engagement)

benchmarks.case: notification list with no owned saved receipt, 500 projects

preservedBehavior: Post source and current user/channel authority are reread after every asynchronous network phase.
Scheduled scans still coalesce, have a ten-probe ceiling, honor six-hour due times, cancellation and stop.
Every 25 candidates yields even when all candidates are skipped; ownership changes during that yield cannot authorize the old owner.
Notification early exit only applies when no saved receipt belongs to the current user. Suppressed/unavailable receipts retain existing current-source validation and error behavior.
Scheduled scans still discover and create new notification metadata. List/read/readAll do not create it.
limitation: Local synthetic measurements, not evidence that these defects caused the production HA reason 23 event. Windows timer granularity contributes to the remaining roughly 14ms zero-timer delay.
